result.contract: Deduplication unit: entire original request key plus ordered effect_ids. Same key with different IDs/order is rejected with PARAMETER_MISMATCH. Exact original key and ordered IDs resumes any unfinished original work and returns its receipts, without repeating committed effects. A fresh key is independent and may execute the same effects again. Records do not expire during this task.
